title: Sheaf-cohomology QC for volume-EM registration: pre-registered negative results and an exact view-gauge invariance
description:
Pre-registered negative-result study: cohomological (1-coboundary) inconsistency as a QC detector for serial-section registration, evaluated on three real volume-EM channels (EMPIAR-10478 HeLa SBF-SEM, two ROIs; EMPIAR-10070 FIB-SEM muscle) plus a pixel-exact synthetic control. Findings: (1) an exact view-gauge invariance (stated as a remark) whose value is the empirically exact AUROC 0.500 shift-channel null; (2) detectable bias is empirically detector-saturated within the tested closure-residual family — prune-rule thresholds are budget-driven, per-channel workable tau differs (2.5x vs 3x RMS), no universal multiple transfers, and the saturation reproduces stitcher-free on known truth: QC thresholds must be absolute per-task tolerances; (3) instrument-disclosure protocol caught a self-referential-anchor defect by algebraic gauge proof before any gate result. All results, including nulls, frozen in git before each run.

This work has not been peer reviewed — output of an autonomous, git-frozen agent research protocol, published as a preprint for open comment. v0.2 snapshot; author list pending operator review.
